name: sora
displayName: Sora (All-in-One Web Scraping & Japan Infra MCP)
description: Ultra-fast web scraping, stealth browser automation, and 37 Japanese public/infrastructure tools for AI agents. Open-source Firecrawl & Tavily alternative.

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Scrape a single URL with fast static fetch or stealth browser rendering into token-optimized Markdown.

tools.name: browser_action
tools.description: Execute interactive multi-turn browser action sequences (clicks, fills, screenshots, scrolling) on modern SPAs.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Deep web search with realtime social trends and optional deep scraping.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Get real-time weather forecasts and rain radar for Japanese cities.

tools.name: disaster_earthquake
tools.description: Fetch live earthquake seismic intensity and tsunami warning information.

tools.name: traffic_road
tools.description: Fetch real-time JARTIC road traffic regulations and congestion reports.

tools.name: gov_law_search
tools.description: Search Japanese statutory laws and extract legal articles via e-Gov Law API v2.

tools.name: gov_diet_minutes
tools.description: Search official Japanese National Diet speeches and committee minutes.
